description: This file defines an Angular component for a Notes Page UI, managing notes display, editing, viewing, and deletion with interactions to a NotesService.

classes.name: NotesPageComponent
classes.description: The main component managing the notes page, including fetching, displaying, editing, and deleting notes.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and fetches the list of notes upon loading.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the NotesService, sorts them, and updates the component state.

methods.name: onAddNew
methods.description: Prepares the UI for creating a new note.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Prepares the UI for editing the selected note.

methods.name: onView
methods.description: Sets the selected note for viewing details.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified note after user confirmation.

methods.name: onEditorSave
methods.description: Saves the note, either creating or updating based on the presence of an ID.

methods.name: closeDetails
methods.description: Clears the selected note to close the details view.

ctags.name: ok
ctags.pattern: /^    const ok = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.confirm('Delete this note?') : true;$/
